name: Haryana Leather Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Haryana Leather Chemicals Ltd deals in chemicals, coatings and dispersions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company has a joint venture with ICAP-SIRA ITALY, and a technical alliance with VISMON –SPAIN. It is an integrated research and manufacturing facility for chemicals for leather, textile, footwear and PVC processing, leather processing, footwear finishing, textile printing, PSA (Pressure Sensitive Adhesives) and PVC additives

pros: Stock is trading at 0.74 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.96% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.96% over last 3 years.
